fields.sched_l_excess_benefit.amt_tax_imposed: First-tier §4958 excise tax imposed on the disqualified person (25% of the excess benefit).
fields.sched_l_excess_benefit.amt_tax_reimburse: Excise tax the organization reimbursed to the disqualified person. A non-zero amount here is itself a new excess-benefit transaction and triggers the 200% second-tier tax.
fields.sched_l_excess_benefit.transaction_corre: Was the excess benefit corrected within the §4958 correction period? Correction eliminates the second-tier tax.
fields.sched_l_excess_benefit.relationship: Free-text description of the disqualified person's relationship to the org (e.g. 'CEO', 'FOUNDER', 'BOARD CHAIR').
fields.sched_l_excess_benefit.description: Free-text description of the excess-benefit transaction itself.
fields.sched_l_loans.original_principal: Original principal of the loan, in dollars.
fields.sched_l_loans.balance_due: Balance due at the end of the tax period, in dollars. A negative value means a credit/refund situation in the relationship.
fields.sched_l_loans.loan_to_organization: True = the interested person loaned money TO the organization.
fields.sched_l_loans.loan_from_organization: True = the organization loaned money TO the interested person. This is the higher-risk direction.
fields.sched_l_loans.written_agreement: True = the loan terms are in a written agreement. ECFA Standard 6 and the Grassley inquiry specifically flagged unwritten officer loans as a fraud pattern.
fields.sched_l_loans.in_default: True = the loan is in default. A forgiven officer loan is itself an excess-benefit transaction under §4958.
fields.sched_l_loans.approved_by_board: True = the loan was approved by the board or board-authorized committee. A unilateral officer loan with no board approval is a §4958 risk signal.
fields.sched_l_loans.relationship: Free-text description of the borrower's relationship to the org (e.g. 'OFFICER', 'BOARD MEMBER', 'FAMILY MEMBER').
fields.sched_l_loans.purpose_of_loan: Free-text description of why the loan was made.
fields.sched_l_grants_to_interested.amount_of_a: Dollar amount of the grant or assistance.
fields.sched_l_grants_to_interested.relationshi: How the recipient is related to the org (officer, family member, substantial contributor, etc.).
fields.sched_l_grants_to_interested.type_of_ass: Form of assistance (scholarship, housing, medical, etc.).
fields.sched_l_business_transactions.transactio: Aggregate dollar amount of the transactions with this interested person during the tax period. Threshold for required disclosure is $100k aggregate per person.
fields.sched_l_business_transactions.relationsh: How the counterparty is related (family member, business affiliate, substantial contributor, etc.).
fields.sched_l_business_transactions.descriptio: Free-text description of what the org bought from or sold to the interested person.
fields.sched_l_business_transactions.sharing_of: True = the org and the interested person split revenues from the transaction (private inurement risk).
fields.sched_r_disregarded.total_income: Total income reported by the disregarded entity, in dollars.
fields.sched_r_disregarded.end_of_year_assets: End-of-year assets held by the disregarded entity, in dollars.
fields.sched_r_disregarded.legal_domicile: US state or foreign country code where the entity is legally domiciled.
fields.sched_r_disregarded.primary_activity: Free-text description of what the disregarded entity does.
fields.sched_r_related_tax_exempt.legal_domicil: US state or foreign country code where the related entity is legally domiciled.
fields.sched_r_related_tax_exempt.exempt_code_s: IRC section under which the related entity is exempt — 501(c)(3) public charity, 501(c)(4) action arm, 501(c)(2) holding company, etc. Canonicalized across 8+ syntactic variants in raw data.
fields.sched_r_related_tax_exempt.public_charit: Sched A reason code for the related entity's public-charity status (line 1-12 of Sched A Part I).
fields.sched_r_related_tax_exempt.section_512b_: True = a 'controlled organization' under IRC §512(b)(13). Triggers UBIT on interest, rent, royalty, and annuity payments between the entities. The Catholic diocese real-estate LLC pattern lives here.
fields.sched_r_related_tax_exempt.primary_activ: Free-text description of the related entity's primary activity.
fields.sched_r_related_partnership.percentage_o: Filer's percentage ownership of the related partnership.
fields.sched_r_related_partnership.share_total_: Filer's share of the partnership's total income, in dollars.
fields.sched_r_related_partnership.share_end_of: Filer's share of the partnership's end-of-year assets, in dollars.
fields.sched_r_related_partnership.general_or_m: True = the filer is a general or managing partner (vs limited partner).
fields.sched_r_related_partnership.disprortion_: True = the partnership uses disproportionate income allocation (a §704(b) allocation that doesn't match capital contributions).
fields.sched_r_related_partnership.primary_pred: Free-text description of the partnership's main income type (rental, services, investment, etc.).
fields.sched_r_related_partnership.legal_domici: US state or foreign country code.
fields.sched_r_related_corp_trust.percentage_ow: Filer's percentage ownership of the related corp/trust.
fields.sched_r_related_corp_trust.share_total_i: Filer's share of the related entity's total income, in dollars.
fields.sched_r_related_corp_trust.share_end_of_: Filer's share of end-of-year assets, in dollars.
fields.sched_r_related_corp_trust.section_512b_: True = controlled organization under §512(b)(13). Triggers UBIT on certain related-party payments.
fields.sched_r_related_corp_trust.legal_domicil: US state or foreign country code.
fields.sched_r_transactions.transaction_amount: Dollar amount of the transaction with the related organization.
fields.sched_r_transactions.transaction_type_co: Single-letter code for the transaction type. See codebook in the methodology drawer for what each letter means.
fields.sched_r_transactions.method_of_determini: How the org valued the transaction (FMV, cost, cash, arm's-length, invoice, etc.). Synonyms canonicalized at data prep.
fields.sched_j_main.first_class_or_charter_trav: True = the org provides first-class or charter travel for officers/key employees.
fields.sched_j_main.travel_companions: True = the org pays for the travel companions of officers/key employees.
fields.sched_j_main.tax_indemnification: True = the org provides tax gross-up payments (org pays the officer's tax bill on certain benefits). Grassley-flagged perk.
fields.sched_j_main.discretionary_spending_acco: True = officers have a discretionary spending account.
fields.sched_j_main.housing_allowance_residence: True = the org provides a housing allowance or residence for personal use. §107 minister housing exclusion lives here; explains why officer 'comp' is systematically understated for ordained ministers.
fields.sched_j_main.personal_services: True = the org pays for personal services for officers (e.g. household staff).
fields.sched_j_main.health_or_social_club_dues: True = the org pays health-club or social-club dues for officers. Grassley-flagged perk.
fields.sched_j_main.written_policy_for_above: True = there is a written policy covering the perks disclosed on this Schedule J.
fields.sched_j_main.compensation_committee: True = a compensation committee sets officer comp.
fields.sched_j_main.independent_compensation_co: True = an independent compensation consultant was used.
fields.sched_j_main.compensation_survey: True = a compensation survey was used.
fields.sched_j_main.approval_by_board_or_comp_c: True = comp was approved by the board or the comp committee.
fields.sched_j_main.severance_payment: True = the org paid severance to a former officer. Golden-parachute risk if not pre-approved with documented comparability.
fields.sched_j_main.supplemental_nonqualified_r: True = the org has a supplemental non-qualified retirement plan (SERP) for officers. Same risk as severance if not properly documented.
fields.sched_j_main.compensation_contingent_on_: True = officer comp is tied to the org's revenues. Private inurement risk under Reg. §1.501(c)(3)-1(c)(2).
True = officer comp is tied to the org's net earnings. Same risk regime; even more direct inurement signal.
fields.sched_j_main.non_fixed_payments: True = the org made bonus or discretionary payments to officers without a fixed written formula.
fields.sched_j_compensation.base_compensation_f: Base salary paid by the filing org, in dollars.
fields.sched_j_compensation.base_compensation_r: Base salary paid by a RELATED organization (Sched R entity). The 'paid through related LLC' disclosure-avoidance pattern.
fields.sched_j_compensation.bonus_filing_org: Bonus / incentive comp from the filing org.
fields.sched_j_compensation.bonus_related_org: Bonus / incentive comp from a related org.
fields.sched_j_compensation.other_filing_org: Other reportable comp from the filing org.
fields.sched_j_compensation.deferred_compensati: Deferred comp set aside by the filing org.
Deferred comp set aside by a related org.
fields.sched_j_compensation.nontaxable_benefits: Non-taxable benefits provided by the filing org.
fields.sched_j_compensation.total_filing_org: Total reportable + other comp from the filing org.
fields.sched_j_compensation.title: Officer's title (e.g. PRESIDENT, EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR). Truncated to ~12 chars in some IRS schema versions.
fields.part_vii_officers.reportable_comp_from_o: W-2 box 1 / 1099 box 7 reportable compensation from the filing org. ~87% of rows are $0 (uncompensated board members).
fields.part_vii_officers.reportable_comp_from_r: Reportable comp from a related organization (Sched R entity). Cross-reference against Sched R to identify which affiliate is paying.
fields.part_vii_officers.other_compensation: Other comp from the filing org (deferred, benefits, etc.).
fields.part_vii_officers.average_hours: Average hours per week the person works for the filing org.
fields.part_vii_officers.individual_trustee_or_: True = serves as individual trustee or director.
fields.part_vii_officers.officer: True = is an officer of the org.
fields.part_vii_officers.key_employee: True = key employee (over the $150k/$210k thresholds plus other tests).
fields.part_vii_officers.highest_compensated_em: True = one of the top-5 highest-paid employees not otherwise listed.
fields.part_vii_officers.former: True = the person is a former officer/director/key employee (still reportable if they received comp during the year).
fields.part_vii_contractors.compensation: Compensation paid to the contractor, in dollars. Required disclosure: top 5 contractors paid >$100k.
fields.part_vii_contractors.contractor_state: US state or foreign country code.
fields.part_vii_contractors.services_descriptio: Free-text description of the services provided.

txn_type_codes.A: Receipt of (i) interest, (ii) annuities, (iii) royalties, or (iv) rent
txn_type_codes.B: Gift, grant, or capital contribution to related organization(s)
txn_type_codes.C: Gift, grant, or capital contribution from related organization(s)
txn_type_codes.D: Loans or loan guarantees to or for related organization(s)
txn_type_codes.E: Loans or loan guarantees by related organization(s)
txn_type_codes.G: Sale of assets to related organization(s)
txn_type_codes.H: Purchase of assets from related organization(s)
txn_type_codes.I: Exchange of assets with related organization(s)
txn_type_codes.J: Lease of facilities, equipment, or other assets to related organization(s)
txn_type_codes.K: Lease of facilities, equipment, or other assets from related organization(s)
txn_type_codes.L: Performance of services or membership or fundraising solicitations for related organization(s)
txn_type_codes.M: Performance of services or membership or fundraising solicitations by related organization(s)
txn_type_codes.N: Sharing of facilities, equipment, mailing lists, or other assets with related organization(s)
txn_type_codes.O: Sharing of paid employees with related organization(s)
txn_type_codes.P: Reimbursement paid to related organization(s) for expenses
txn_type_codes.Q: Reimbursement paid by related organization(s) for expenses
txn_type_codes.R: Other transfer of cash or property to related organization(s)
txn_type_codes.S: Other transfer of cash or property from related organization(s)
